desc:
Scam with your friends. Make money. Don’t get caught. 💸

🤑 Pull off ridiculous scams with your friends
🎭 Trick NPCs and convince them to hand over their cash
💼 Complete quests and DON'T GET CAUGHT!.
💰 Earn money and upgrade your scamming gear
🏠 Unlock new locations, tools, and opportunities [SOON]
🚨 Avoid getting raided, caught, or FIRED!

🔥 The more money you make, the crazier and riskier the scams become.

Will you make it the whole week?

👹 Take on huge high-risk scams with your crew
⚔️ Work together… or completely betray your friends
💎 Hit the jackpot and escape with the quota
🏆 Unlock exclusive classes and become the boss

📱 Playable on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console

💸 Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate scammer?

⚠️ This game is fictional and made for entertainment. Don’t scam people in real life please.
